before.name: ONE-PAN BEEF, CORN AND PTITIM!
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until it starts to soften. Season with salt, black pepper, turmeric, and garlic powder, and stir for about 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef. Using a wooden spoon break it up and stir occasionally, until browned. About 7-8 minutes.
Stir in the frozen corn, p’titim, chopped dill and cilantro, and date syrup. Mix well, then pour in the boiling water and stir again.

Cover with a lid, reduce heat to low, and cook until the liquid is absorbed and the p’titim is tender. If it looks dry before the p’titim is soft, add a small splash of water and keep cooking covered.

before.name: ARUK ARAYES!
ingredients: 6 golden potatoes, peeled and cooked until very soft
6 scallions (green onions), finely chopped, including the green part
instructions: In a bowl mash the cooked potatoes to a slightly chunky consistency and let them cool slightly.
Add the scallions, parsley, ground beef, salt, pepper, turmeric, garlic powder, baharat and egg. Mix very well until evenly combined.
Open up each pita half and stuff it with the Beef Aruk mixture.
On the stove on medium heat, pour 5 tablespoons of olive oil into a grilling pan.

before.name: MY VIRAL OVEN-BAKED SCHNITZEL
ingredients: 2 pounds of of thin chicken cutlets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 420°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, combine the chicken cutlets, eggs, salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, Dijon mustard, honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, and garlic. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated.
In a separate dish, mix the panko, breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, and garlic powder. Coat each cutlet on both sides, pressing the crumbs gently onto the chicken.
Arrange the cutlets in a single layer on a baking pan. Drizzle the olive oil over them.
